policy: Publication, downloadable product, inspected file and render-validated layer are separate evidence stages. No invented geometry, no target verification upgrade.

candidates.title: GIS Shapefiles of Arc Pass, Mars
candidates.publishing_organization: Author archive / Figshare; associated peer-reviewed JGR Planets study
candidates.authors: Joel Davis; associated paper Davis and coauthors
candidates.file_format: ZIP containing ESRI File Geodatabase (not standalone .shp despite title)
candidates.actual_download_availability: Downloaded 94,771 bytes; published MD5 matches; ZIP integrity passed.
candidates.longitude_convention: East-positive, 0–360 at source footprint; longitude wrap to signed display is identity at 137 E.
candidates.latitude_convention: Source sphere: planetocentric/planetographic coincide on the sphere; adopted planetocentric display independently checked against explicit PDS centric localizations and map label.

projection_parameters.units: metres; default standard parallel zero independently checked against spherical inverse

candidates.nominal_scale_or_native_resolution: Published figure 17: digitized at 1:250 on HiRISE; scale is not positional accuracy.
candidates.observation_or_mapping_basis: HiRISE mapping augmented by Mastcam/Navcam observations; paper DOI 10.1029/2025JE009538 (2026), figure 17.
candidates.processing_requirements: Read OpenFileGDB; validate; inverse project on Mars sphere; preserve Unit and source OBJECTID; discard constant zero Z without asserting elevation; no simplification, clipping or boundary repair.
uncertainty_and_limitations: Only Arc Pass; not a whole Gediz Vallis or formation boundary.
Seven source Unit codes retained; no unverified expansion of abbreviations. Display palette is Marswalk styling, not original published colors.
Absolute registration uncertainty unspecified; CTX is much coarser than the mapping.
Tiny source topology gaps/overlaps preserved; no hazard inference.
candidates.attribution_requirements: Joel Davis (2025), Figshare, CC BY 4.0; cite associated Davis et al. (2026) paper.
candidates.maplibre_suitability: Validated 53-feature categorical GeoJSON in the shared renderer. Source Unit values exactly match legend; opacity and focus extent browser-checked; no target or mission verification upgrade.
candidates.source_legend_limitations: Codes are authoritative attributes. F1/F2/F3 and mixed-facies context are described in the associated paper. MSg/R/S remain unexpanded pending independent semantic review. Palette is display styling.
